rows.text: Kantei's account 第２次森内閣発足 states that after the special session convened on 4 July 2000 re-designated 森総理 by agreeing votes of both Houses, he formed the second Mori cabinet and was appointed that night at the Imperial appointment ceremony as the 86th Prime Minister (55th person).
